name: We must adapt chat view for mobile.
description:
# Summary

We identified mobile adaptation needs for the ChatView component in the codx-junior chat application. The layout required responsive changes to accommodate smaller screens where persistent sidebars consume excessive space. We implemented a DaisyUI drawer pattern to hide the sidebar by default on mobile devices and make it accessible via a toggle button. The header was simplified for mobile with a collapsible menu, and all modals were optimized for touch interaction and smaller viewports. The solution maintains full desktop functionality while providing an intuitive mobile-first experience.
